chunks: So extol God when the evening comes and the day dawns,
ai.seo_question: When should one recite Tasbih according to Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tasbih al-Zahra* (the glorification of Fatimah al-Zahra), where the evening and morning transitions are seen as optimal times for dhikr to maintain spiritual vigilance. It underscores the importance of integrating worship into the daily rhythm of life, transforming natural cycles into opportunities for divine connection and remembrance.
